name: Mystery Goo
label: Quest
description: Mystery Goo: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The greenish substance inside the cauldron appears to be similar to what you found in the flask. This strange gooey stuff could be as corrupted as the furbolg that created it...
If the Winterfall furbolg are using it, does this mean that they will soon be as corrupted as the Deadwood tribe?
It would be best to report back to Donova with your findings, along with a sample of the liquid in the cauldron.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I hope you found something, friend. The Winterfall are becoming increasingly aggressive!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are very resourceful, friend. Do you think that the Winterfall furbolgs have been to the Deadwood camp?
